description: Format source-neutral minimum and maximum software-version bounds.
documentation_wikitext:
__NOTOC__
Format source-neutral minimum and maximum software-version bounds.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Version range|min_name=Alpha|min_build=1|max_name=Beta|max_build=2|max_exclusive=yes}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Omit optional parameters that do not apply. The parameter reference below lists supported names and aliases.

examples.description: An inclusive minimum and exclusive maximum.

parameters.description: Release name at the lower endpoint.
parameters.label: Minimum version name
parameters.name: min_name

parameters.description: Exact build identifier at the lower endpoint.
parameters.label: Minimum build
parameters.name: min_build

parameters.description: Optional pre-rendered icon for the minimum endpoint.
parameters.label: Minimum icon content
parameters.name: min_icon_content

parameters.description: Release name at the upper endpoint.
parameters.label: Maximum version name
parameters.name: max_name

parameters.description: Exact build identifier at the upper endpoint.
parameters.label: Maximum build
parameters.name: max_build

parameters.description: Optional pre-rendered icon for the maximum endpoint.
parameters.label: Maximum icon content
parameters.name: max_icon_content
